iter_evals.query: Search for UK/US legal and self-regulatory sources on influencer marketing to minors for a YouTube vlog sponsorship by Surfshark VPN: FTC Act §5, FTC Endorsement Guides (16 CFR Part 255), FTC .com Disclosures, COPPA, CAP Code/ASA guidance, CMA influencer advertising guidance, and platform branded-content disclosure rules on clear and conspicuous disclosure of paid promotion (#ad, sponsored, description-box-only disclosures). Include authorities on misleading VPN/cybersecurity claims and unsubstantiated representations about privacy, malware protection, public Wi‑Fi safety, IP switching/access to geo-restricted streaming libraries or government sites, plus any rules on direct exhortation or child-directed advertising for digital services.

Find current advertising law and platform guidance applicable to influencer endorsements of VPN/cybersecurity services in YouTube videos, especially: FTC Endorsement Guides and .com Disclosures; YouTube paid promotion/disclosure rules; UK ASA/CAP and CMA influencer ad disclosure rules; rules/guidance on substantiating cybersecurity/privacy claims such as 'keeps you safe online,' 'protecting you from using public Wi‑Fi,' 'encrypting your data,' 'alerts you if they notice malware,' and claims about accessing Netflix libraries/government websites by switching IP addresses; plus any legal guidance on advertising VPNs for bypassing geo-restrictions/streaming access.

Canada influencer advertising disclosure requirements Competition Bureau testimonial/endorsement guidance social media sponsorship disclosure VPN advertising claims privacy/security encryption malware alerts geo-unblocking misleading advertising
